name: Project adaptation: discovering custom directory and numbering conventions
query: A legacy plugin repository stores its ADRs under docs/decisions/ using 3-digit numbering (e.g. 001-initial-architecture.md, 002-use-react-in-admin.md). How does the skill adapt without forcing docs/adr/ or 4-digit prefixes?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Execute detect-adr-conventions.mjs against target repository
Step 3: Discover established numbering style: 'numeric-3' with pad width 3
Step 4: Identify highest existing sequence number (002) and compute next number as '003'
Step 5: Generate new record as docs/decisions/003-new-decision.md
Step 6: Respect existing convention without altering historical files or paths
success_criteria: Avoids forcing default docs/adr/ on established repository
